name: Clam River
gaugeName: CLAM RIVER AT HWY 35 NR WEBSTER, WI
blurb: Clam River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.takeOut: Charles Tollander Memorial Park Canoe Launch
sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Clam Lake and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.

notices.title: Launch below Clam Dam
notices.text: Burnett County identifies the canoe landing on the south bank east of Clam Dam. Use that downstream landing, not the upstream flowage. The marker shows the access area; confirm the signed approach and stay clear of the dam.

putInAccess.operator: Burnett County Forest & Parks (ownership 'County' in the WDNR record)
putInAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency-listed access area; the marker does not identify the exact water-edge landing. Confirm the signed approach and current access conditions with the site manager. DNR notes that non-DNR sites in this inventory are not actively maintained.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public approach to Clam Dam Park Canoe Launch. The map shows the access area; find the designated landing on arrival and check current site conditions.
